premises.text: Restaurants have perishable table inventory with high fixed costs yet ~40% underutilization and flat prices across peak/off-peak demand
premises.evidence_span: about 40% of the restaurant inventory is underutilized due to lack of revenue or yield management

premises.text: Poor forecasting and suboptimal pricing contribute to large food waste and high restaurant failure rates
premises.evidence_span: food is wasted on a daily basis. That's a lot of food going down to the hog farms, wasted because restaurants, A, are not able to forecast properly, B, they are not able to price their product optimally

premises.text: ResGuru consolidates online/offline reservations and POS into analytics (utilization, RevPASH) for restaurant operators
premises.evidence_span: all my reservations, all my food orders are consolidated from across all the online and offline channels for my restaurant

premises.text: Dynamic pricing uses goals, overbooking/walk-in rules, channel commissions, and ~21 macro/micro variables to recommend time-slot prices
premises.evidence_span: a dynamic pricing platform for restaurants. It allows the restaurants to automatically change their prices based on demand and supply

premises.text: B2B go-to-market to restaurant owners (private beta) on top of an existing restaurant digitization footprint
premises.evidence_span: we welcome all of you who are restaurant owners to sign up with us

value.text: Optimize restaurant revenue/utilization via demand-based pricing (and better deals for diners)
value.evidence_span: help them optimize their revenue, but also get you better deals in your restaurants

secondary_value.text: Reduce food waste through better forecast and pricing
secondary_value.evidence_span: not able to forecast properly, B, they are not able to price their product optimally to sell it at the right point
